summary: YNX Exchange is a repository-owned testnet spot venue. It provides a deterministic price-time order book, Wallet-authorized execution, persistent audit/reconciliation and a bounded Quant Execution Adapter. It is not a production custody venue and does not claim public liquidity, volume or returns.
features: Deterministic fixed-point Spot CLOB with price-time priority
Limit, protected Market IOC, Post-only, IOC, FOK, amend, stop, take-profit, trailing, OCO, TWAP, iceberg and scale execution
Persistent Market, User and Drop Copy event streams
Wallet-signed dead-man switch and persistent Quant strategy kill
Quant mandates with exact subaccount, market, methods, aggregate capital, expiry and nonce domain
Responsive Web Pro terminal and separate Android/iOS mobile product
risks: Testnet venue only; YUSD_TEST is internal venue credit
No public runtime, hosted download, production signature or store release is attested
Central Wallet/Gateway, custody and authoritative Indexer acceptance remain pending
Margin, perpetual, portfolio margin, UltraLiquidity and solvency proof are not implemented
No guaranteed liquidity, price, execution, profit or return
Historical schema v2-v7 compatibility lacks immutable byte fixtures

faq.question: Is YNX Exchange live with real funds?
faq.answer: No. The current release is a locally tested testnet venue. Public deployment, production custody and live-funds operation are not claimed.

faq.question: Does YNX Exchange provide real market liquidity?
faq.answer: The order book and trade tape contain only persisted YNX testnet orders and matches. No third-party depth, volume or price is fabricated.

faq.question: Can a Quant strategy withdraw assets or change account ownership?
faq.answer: No. The Quant adapter structurally forbids withdrawals, owner changes, withdrawal-address changes, unapproved transfers, risk overrides and API-key export.

faq.question: What happens when a Quant strategy is killed?
faq.answer: A separate Wallet signature permanently revokes that nonce domain and atomically cancels the subaccount's orders for the market. Resumption requires a newly signed mandate with a new nonce domain.

faq.question: Are margin and perpetual products available?
faq.answer: No. Margin, perpetual, portfolio-margin, liquidation and funding engines are not implemented and are not emulated.
